media.reason: Static restored container and turf state is observable in a still; ordered runtime assertions/logs cover export/import. No motion or timing claim is made.

steps: Run tests/world_save/run.ps1 with BYOND 516.1681, then with -Large for 500x500x2 scale acceptance.

Run tests/world_save/run-game.ps1 with BYOND 516.1681 and -Visual; the script generates a root probe environment from civ13.dme plus the committed helper, and copies it and public config assets to new temporary storage.
The probe creates a real crate and nested knife at (20,20,1), exports, imports and asserts preservation using normal game startup and constructors.

Connect Dream Seeker to the loopback port in startup.log; select Local Verification and Inspect restored save. Double-click the native title bar to maximize and capture the restored crate and actual result/commit/dimensions in chat.
Stop only the identified copied probe daemon after capture; preserve closed logs and original/synthetic saves.

Baseline comparison restores functions/saving/loading from origin/master 0d38999d5f9f987a944493f11c456537f39ac2f6 in a separate generated environment, disables outbound hooks, and runs startup in new temporary storage.
